about.title: A bit more about me
about.p1: Hello, my name is Ramiro and I build complete web applications, from the frontend experience to the business logic and communication with backend servers.
about.p2: I started programming in high school. At a school fair, together with one of my computer science teachers, I built a video game in Scratch. That project was a turning point: it showed me how fun it is to create things from scratch and solve problems creatively.
about.p3: That teacher played an important role in my choice to become a developer: he pushed me, motivated me to keep learning, and helped me see programming in a different way. Since then, I try to apply that mindset in every project: build with intention, improve iteration by iteration, and care about details.
